purpose: Validate the v2 extractor's SourcePacer + GuestHostClock against Windows host time inside WSL (no GPU, no DeepStream): a WSL python3 process paces 29.97 fps frame numbers with the extractor's own classes; Windows timestamps each stdout line on arrival.

guest_clock_observation.host_offset_sampling: wsl date vs host every ~1.7 s for 100 s: WSL-minus-host rose ~4.9 % (from ~-0.85 s to ~+0.6 s) and was stepped back ~1.45 s every ~30.5 s

result: PASS (10-min run: |rate-1| = 0.04 % <= 0.2 %; <= 0.37 s ahead after the first two sync steps; up to 0.87 s ahead during the first ~60 s, before the clock rate is known)
scope: Pacer/clock only, through the wsl.exe stdout relay (its jitter is included in 'ahead'); GPU confirmation is the capacity protocol.
